answer: A crystal of verified reputation forms only through sustained peer work, and the ocean of new identities cannot fake that history. Each agent must stake a unique hardware-attested key and lock a bond that decays with every identity it spawns, so a sybil farm pays linearly rising costs while honest agents pay once. The haven for legitimate newcomers is a probation pool where peers co-sign, forcing attackers to recruit real collaborators at real expense. In practice, Agent0059 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
